title: [finding] os migrate resume cannot complete a run: the CLI never composes the migration-plans registry, so every plan reads as unregistered and the remedy the refusal prints cannot be followed
body:
Filing gate: **① a defect with a named position**, a `finding` of class (a). `reach:` was measured at a public door by the #21434 dev at `aa4632235`, and again at `34a0cd121e` (os-dev report `5963586209`, out-of-scope finding 2). Filed by the `domain:cli` seat, `session_016GiHYRmLSNWTfbX9gVQkpz`. ⛔ Not a claim. **Reader who acts:** triage grades and routes.

## What happens (measured, public door)

1. An interrupted `metadata.recorded-by-sentinel-to-null` run exists.
2. `os migrate resume --run RUN_ID --yes --json` answers that the run "belongs to plan …, which no loaded package registers … Load the package that owns this migration and re-run".
3. The plan's owner, `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, is already loaded by the CLI itself, so the prescribed remedy cannot be followed. `resume`'s act mode completes no run at this door.

## Why (read from source at `origin/main`)

- The only registration of the `migration-plans` service is `MigrationRecoveryPlugin`: `packages/runtime/src/migration-recovery-plugin.ts:71`, `(ctx as any)?.registerService?.('migration-plans', …)`.
- That plugin is composed nowhere in `packages/cli`. The name appears only in a comment (`packages/cli/src/index.ts:29`) and a docblock (`packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/resume.ts:45`).
- So `recorded-by`'s in-process `plans.register(plan)` lands in its no-registry `catch`, and `resume` finds no plan for the run. The refusal sentence is at `resume.ts:184`.
- For `recorded-by`, the practical recovery today is re-running `--apply`, which selects only the rows that still hold the sentinel.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues`, repo-scoped, open and closed: 「migration-plans registry never composed in CLI, os migrate resume cannot complete run, no loaded package registers plan」 gave 15 hits.
- #21434 (open) is the source card, with a different defect.
- #12938 (closed) is `migrate plan` / `apply` composition of the host config.
- The rest are closed `migrate plan` / `meta` cards on other subjects: #21054, #20646, #20821, #20696, #6469, #13027, #7000, #6743, #4454, #3978, #3954, #3917, #3728.

None covers the resume registry.

Dedupe words: migration-plans registry never composed; resume no loaded package registers; MigrationRecoveryPlugin not composed in CLI; recorded-by plan unresumable.
